Hi Marissa / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo today — really helpful. Per our internal discussion, wanted to capture the initial success criteria and ask for a proposed evaluation plan and owners from your side. High-level success criteria from Stellar:  

- Latency: 95th percentile under 300ms for our 1k token median payloads
- Throughput: sustained 5 requests/sec during simulated peak window
- Functional correctness: <= 10% error rate on our 3 canonical prompt cases (see attached)
- Data handling: logs/audit events must remain in our US region and meet our retention policy

We'd like a 3-week POC window starting the week of Feb 16, with a midpoint check and final readiness sign-off. Can you send:  
1) A proposed evaluation plan and timeline
2) Ownership (who will be the Redwood contacts for infra/CS/eng)
3) Any known risks or blockers you've seen for similar POCs

I've attached our draft SOW (Stellar_POC_SOW.pdf) and a small sample set of prompts. Happy to jump on a short kickoff if helpful.

Thanks,
Alex

FWIW, a couple of technical risk items to flag early so we can avoid surprises during Week 1:  

1) Streaming / KV cache regression (medium-high) — we observed a bug in our streaming path that can cause truncated responses when KV cache is warmed and payloads exceed ~900 tokens. Symptoms: partial tokens + increased retry rate. Mitigation: disable streaming for the baseline runs (no functional impact) and apply a hotfix. Owner: dev_patel. ETA for hotfix (if needed): 48 hours after confirmed repro.

2) Quantization compatibility (low-medium) — some third-party model variants used in-house can have different tokenization edge cases. We'll validate tokenization on your sample prompts in Week 0. Owner: dev_patel.

3) Regioned logging (low) — we can ensure logs persist in US region but need your S3/Bucket ACL details and retention policy. Owner: monica_patel for coordination.

I've attached a short error log from a recent repro when streaming was enabled (streaming_error_log.txt). If we can keep baseline runs non-streaming, that avoids the blocking behavior while we push the fix.

- Dev
